settings.title: About us
settings.text:
Fitness Superstore Inc. was founded in 2010 with the goal of becoming your one-stop shop for some of the biggest brands in gym equipment. 
We offer brand new and remanufactured gym equipment 
for home and commercial use.

With 14 years of expertise, our mission is to deliver top-tier gym equipment at mid-range prices, distinguished by our renowned customer service, transparency, and integrity. We have a proven process, refined over years of dedication, ensuring quality is accessible to all without a hefty price tag. 

Through standing by our mission, Fitness Superstore has become a brand trusted by thousands, driving an average of $15 million annual sales. Our company now has 100 employees, and is continuously growing.

settings.title: Remanufactured Equipment
settings.text: Marketed at 70% off their retail prices, we carry a long list of industry-trusted brands that are remanufactured cosmetically and mechanically to like-new condition.
settings.popup_text:
Marketed at 70% off their retail prices, we carry a long list of industry-trusted brands, including Cybex, Precor, Life Fitness, Technogym, Matrix, Stairmaster, Star Trac, and Woodway. The equipment is taken from commercial fitness facilities that are upgrading or are closing their doors. We then remanufacture them to like-new condition.

All remanufactured machines include a 1 year warranty covering parts and on-site labor. We also offer extended warranties of 2, 3, 4, and 5 years parts & on site labor. This will guarantee your machine works like a brand new machine for the period of the warranty. Is your machine squeaking? Heart rate not working? Is the screen not responding quickly? Call us, we will send a technician to your house free of charge.

settings.title: French Fitness
settings.text: Fitness Superstore is the exclusive dealer of French Fitness, offering everything you need for a commercial or home gym.
settings.popup_text:
In 2019, Fitness Superstore Inc developed French Fitness, its own brand of gym equipment and currently stands as its exclusive dealer. French Fitness offers everything you need for a commercial or home gym– from gym flooring to treadmills, ellipticals, exercise bikes, steppers, stair mills, rowers, air bikes, and strength training equipment including cross training equipment, rack and rig systems, selectorized equipment, plate loaded equipment, free weights, benches, multi functional equipment, gym accessories and attachments, plyo and speed training, and more.

French Fitness products are assembled in the USA. They pride themselves for delivering industry-standard quality, excellent customer service, extensive warranties (10 year parts, 1 year labor).

settings.title: Top Quality Remanufactured Gym Equipment
settings.text: At Fitness Superstore, quality is our top priority. Every equipment goes through a rigorous inspection, testing, and quality assurance process to ensure that every aspect of your Fitness Superstore machines work perfectly.

settings.title: Extensive and Top of the Industry Remanufactured Warranty
settings.text: Our remanufactured equipment comes with 1-year parts and labor warranty standard on all our remanufactured products, along with extended warranty options of up to 5 years, while brand new equipment maintain their original brand’s warranties.

settings.title: Parent Company of French Fitness With 10-Year Warranty
settings.text: French Fitness offers high-quality gym equipment at affordable prices, comparable to top global brands. Our products come with a 10-year parts warranty and a 1-year labor warranty, excluding weights and accessories. Customers can inspect and compare our products in person at our showroom or via a live Facetime call, with assistance from our staff. Whether for a home gym or a commercial fitness center, we ensure you get the best value for your money.

settings.title: Dedicated Customer Service

settings.title: Full Service Delivery and Assembly Options
settings.text: We provide full-service gym equipment delivery and installation at reasonable prices, leveraging our own delivery fleet, extensive warehouse staff, and partnerships with top couriers to offer flexible options for both US-based and international customers.

Whether you’re running a commercial gym, a government fitness facility, or simply want to have a uniform set of home gym equipment, we can do it all for you.
